#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
cap=10
status=0
for file in skills/*/SKILL.md; do
  lines="$(grep -c '' "$file")"
  if [ "$lines" -gt "$cap" ]; then
    echo "FAIL: $file is $lines/$cap lines"
    status=1
  fi
done
exit "$status"
